PRIVACY WARNING: Enabling file access

By enabling this tool, you grant this application and any connected AI services permission to:
• Browse files and directories on this device's shared storage
• Read the content of files, including photos, documents and downloads

You acknowledge that:
• Files on your device may contain sensitive personal information
• Connected AI services may process file contents according to their privacy policies
• On Android 13+ access to shared storage is limited to media files (images, video, audio)
• You can revoke access at any time by disabling this tool

We do not store your files, but connected AI services may process this information according to their privacy policies.
